data.comment:
{StrContains="OutputModule"} {0} is a placeholder for the name of a directory {1} is a placeholder for an error message from the inner exception
Reviewed by TArcher on 2010-07-21
Example usage: PS C:\> $s = New-PSSession PS C:\> Export-PSSession -Session $s -OutputModule gibberish:here Export-PSSession : Cannot create the module 'gibberish:here' due to the following: Cannot find drive. A drive with the name 'gibberish' does not exist. Use a different argument for the -OutputModule parameter and try again.
